## Summary

`UserViewSet` defines `create()` and `update()` with superuser-protection checks, but inherits `destroy()` from `DestroyModelMixin` with no override. The Django `User` model has no `owner` field, so `PaperlessObjectPermissions.has_object_permission()` returns `True`. A non-superuser with `delete_user` permission can delete superuser accounts.

## Description

`UserViewSet` (`src/paperless/views.py:143-192`) checks `request.user.is_superuser` before allowing `is_superuser=True` or `is_staff=True` in `create()` and `update()`. The `destroy()` method inherits from `DestroyModelMixin` with no such check. The `User` model lacks an `owner` field, so `PaperlessObjectPermissions.has_object_permission()` (`src/documents/permissions.py:44-51`) falls through to its "no owner" branch and returns `True` for all user objects.
